1	# AI Evolution: Research, Industry, and Regulation Datasets
2	
3	## Overview
4	Four datasets tracking the parallel development of AI across research, industry adoption, regulation, and private investment from 2010 to 2025.
5	
6	## Data Source
7	
8	### research_milestones
9	15 key research breakthroughs from AlexNet (2012) to frontier models (2025). Each entry has date, label, significance level (medium/high/critical), and a detail description.
10	
11	### industry_milestones
12	13 industry adoption events from Siri (2011) to AI coding agents (2025). Same structure as research milestones.
13	
14	### regulation_milestones

1	# Mermaid.js Configuration & Theming
2	
3	Configuration options, theming, and customization for Mermaid.js v11.
4	
5	## Configuration Methods
6	
7	**1. Site-wide Initialization:**
8	```javascript
9	mermaid.initialize({
10	  theme: 'dark',
11	  startOnLoad: true,
12	  securityLevel: 'strict',
13	  fontFamily: 'Arial'
14	});
15	```
16	
17	**2. Diagram-level Frontmatter:**
18	````markdown
19	```mermaid
20	---
21	theme: forest
22	look: handDrawn
23	---
24	flowchart TD
25	  A --> B
26	```
27	````
28	
29	**3. Configuration Hierarchy:**
30	Default config → Site config → Diagram config (highest priority)
31	
32	## Core Options
33	
34	**Rendering:**
35	- `startOnLoad`: Auto-render on page load (default: true)
36	- `securityLevel`: "strict" (default), "loose", "antiscript", "sandbox"
37	- `deterministicIds`: Reproducible SVG IDs (default: false)
38	- `maxTextSize`: Max diagram text (default: 50000)
39	- `maxEdges`: Max drawable edges (default: 500)
40	
41	**Visual Style:**
42	- `look`: "classic" (default), "handDrawn"
43	- `handDrawnSeed`: Numeric seed for hand-drawn consistency
44	- `darkMode`: Boolean toggle
45	
46	**Typography:**
47	- `fontFamily`: "trebuchet ms, verdana, arial, sans-serif" (default)
48	- `fontSize`: Base text size (default: 16)
49	
50	**Layout:**
51	- `layout`: "dagre" (default), "elk", "tidy-tree", "cose-bilkent"
52	
53	**Debug:**
54	- `logLevel`: 0-5 from trace to fatal
55	- `htmlLabels`: Enable HTML in labels (default: false)
56	
57	## Theming
58	
59	**Built-in Themes:**
60	- `default` - Standard colors
61	- `dark` - Dark background
62	- `forest` - Green tones
63	- `neutral` - Grayscale
64	- `base` - Fully customizable
65	
66	**Theme Variables (base theme only):**
67	```javascript
68	mermaid.initialize({
69	  theme: 'base',
70	  themeVariables: {
71	    primaryColor: '#ff0000',
72	    primaryTextColor: '#fff',
73	    primaryBorderColor: '#7C0000',
74	    secondaryColor: '#006100',
75	    tertiaryColor: '#fff'
76	  }
77	});
78	```
79	
80	**Customizable Variables:**
81	- Color families: primary, secondary, tertiary
82	- Node backgrounds and text colors
83	- Border and line colors
84	- Note background/text
85	- Diagram-specific (flowchart nodes, sequence actors, pie sections)
86	
87	**Custom CSS:**
88	```javascript
89	mermaid.initialize({
90	  themeCSS: `
91	    .node rect { fill: #f9f; }
92	    .edgeLabel { background-color: white; }
93	  `
94	});
95	```
96	
97	## Accessibility
98	
99	**ARIA Support:**
100	```
101	accTitle: Diagram Title
102	accDescr: Brief description
103	accDescr {
104	  Multi-line detailed
105	  description
106	}
107	```
108	
109	**Auto-generated:**
110	- `aria-roledescription` attributes
111	- `<title>` and `<desc>` SVG elements
112	- `aria-labelledby` and `aria-describedby`
113	
114	**WCAG Compliance:**
115	Available for all diagram types (flowchart, sequence, class, Gantt, etc.)
116	
117	## Icon Configuration
118	
119	**Register Icon Packs:**
120	```javascript
121	import { registerIconPacks } from 'mermaid';
122	registerIconPacks([
123	  {
124	    name: 'logos',
125	    loader: () => import('https://esm.run/@iconify-json/logos')
126	  }
127	]);
128	```
129	
130	**Usage:**
131	```
132	architecture-beta
133	  service api(logos:nodejs)[API]
134	```
135	
136	**Loading Methods:**
137	1. CDN-based (lazy loading)
138	2. npm with dynamic import
139	3. Direct import
140	
141	## Math Rendering
142	
143	**KaTeX Support:**
144	```
145	graph LR
146	  A["$$f(x) = x^2$$"] --> B
147	```
148	
149	**Configuration:**
150	- `legacyMathML`: Use old MathML rendering
151	- `forceLegacyMathML`: Force legacy even if browser supports native
152	
153	## Security
154	
155	**Security Levels:**
156	- `strict` - HTML encoding (default, recommended)
157	- `loose` - Some HTML allowed
158	- `antiscript` - Filter scripts
159	- `sandbox` - Sandboxed mode
160	
161	**DOMPurify:**
162	Enabled by default for XSS protection. Customize via `dompurifyConfig` (use caution).
163	
164	## Layout Algorithms
165	
166	**dagre (default):**
167	Standard hierarchical layout for most diagrams.
168	
169	**elk:**
170	Advanced layout with better handling of complex graphs.
171	
172	**tidy-tree:**
173	Clean tree structures for hierarchies.
174	
175	**cose-bilkent:**
176	Compound graph layout for nested structures.
177	
178	**Per-diagram Configuration:**
179	````markdown
180	```mermaid
181	---
182	layout: elk
183	---
184	flowchart TD
185	  A --> B
186	```
187	````
188	
189	## Common Patterns
190	
191	**Consistent Hand-drawn Style:**
192	```javascript
193	mermaid.initialize({
194	  look: 'handDrawn',
195	  handDrawnSeed: 42  // Same seed = consistent appearance
196	});
197	```
198	
199	**Dark Mode Toggle:**
200	```javascript
201	const isDark = window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches;
202	mermaid.initialize({
203	  theme: isDark ? 'dark' : 'default'
204	});
205	```
206	
207	**Performance Optimization:**
208	```javascript
209	mermaid.initialize({
210	  startOnLoad: false,  // Manual rendering
211	  maxEdges: 1000,       // Increase for complex graphs
212	  deterministicIds: true  // Caching-friendly
213	});
214	```
215	
216	## Validation
217	
218	**Parse without Rendering:**
219	```javascript
220	try {
221	  await mermaid.parse('graph TD\nA-->B');
222	  console.log('Valid syntax');
223	} catch(e) {
224	  console.error('Invalid:', e);
225	}
226	```
227	
228	**Programmatic Rendering:**
229	```javascript
230	const { svg } = await mermaid.render('graphId', 'graph TD\nA-->B');
231	document.getElementById('output').innerHTML = svg;
232	```

# Mermaid.js Configuration & Theming

Configuration options, theming, and customization for Mermaid.js v11.

## Configuration Methods

**1. Site-wide Initialization:**
```javascript
mermaid.initialize({
  theme: 'dark',
  startOnLoad: true,
  securityLevel: 'strict',
  fontFamily: 'Arial'
});
```

**2. Diagram-level Frontmatter:**
````markdown
```mermaid
---
theme: forest
look: handDrawn
---
flowchart TD
  A --> B
```
````

**3. Configuration Hierarchy:**
Default config → Site config → Diagram config (highest priority)

## Core Options

**Rendering:**
- `startOnLoad`: Auto-render on page load (default: true)
- `securityLevel`: "strict" (default), "loose", "antiscript", "sandbox"
- `deterministicIds`: Reproducible SVG IDs (default: false)
- `maxTextSize`: Max diagram text (default: 50000)
- `maxEdges`: Max drawable edges (default: 500)

**Visual Style:**
- `look`: "classic" (default), "handDrawn"
- `handDrawnSeed`: Numeric seed for hand-drawn consistency
- `darkMode`: Boolean toggle

**Typography:**
- `fontFamily`: "trebuchet ms, verdana, arial, sans-serif" (default)
- `fontSize`: Base text size (default: 16)

**Layout:**
- `layout`: "dagre" (default), "elk", "tidy-tree", "cose-bilkent"

**Debug:**
- `logLevel`: 0-5 from trace to fatal
- `htmlLabels`: Enable HTML in labels (default: false)

## Theming

**Built-in Themes:**
- `default` - Standard colors
- `dark` - Dark background
- `forest` - Green tones
- `neutral` - Grayscale
- `base` - Fully customizable

**Theme Variables (base theme only):**
```javascript
mermaid.initialize({
  theme: 'base',
  themeVariables: {
    primaryColor: '#ff0000',
    primaryTextColor: '#fff',
    primaryBorderColor: '#7C0000',
    secondaryColor: '#006100',
    tertiaryColor: '#fff'
  }
});
```

**Customizable Variables:**
- Color families: primary, secondary, tertiary
- Node backgrounds and text colors
- Border and line colors
- Note background/text
- Diagram-specific (flowchart nodes, sequence actors, pie sections)

**Custom CSS:**
```javascript
mermaid.initialize({
  themeCSS: `
    .node rect { fill: #f9f; }
    .edgeLabel { background-color: white; }
  `
});
```

## Accessibility

**ARIA Support:**
```
accTitle: Diagram Title
accDescr: Brief description
accDescr {
  Multi-line detailed
  description
}
```

**Auto-generated:**
- `aria-roledescription` attributes
- `<title>` and `<desc>` SVG elements
- `aria-labelledby` and `aria-describedby`

**WCAG Compliance:**
Available for all diagram types (flowchart, sequence, class, Gantt, etc.)

## Icon Configuration

**Register Icon Packs:**
```javascript
import { registerIconPacks } from 'mermaid';
registerIconPacks([
  {
    name: 'logos',
    loader: () => import('https://esm.run/@iconify-json/logos')
  }
]);
```

**Usage:**
```
architecture-beta
  service api(logos:nodejs)[API]
```

**Loading Methods:**
1. CDN-based (lazy loading)
2. npm with dynamic import
3. Direct import

## Math Rendering

**KaTeX Support:**
```
graph LR
  A["$$f(x) = x^2$$"] --> B
```

**Configuration:**
- `legacyMathML`: Use old MathML rendering
- `forceLegacyMathML`: Force legacy even if browser supports native

## Security

**Security Levels:**
- `strict` - HTML encoding (default, recommended)
- `loose` - Some HTML allowed
- `antiscript` - Filter scripts
- `sandbox` - Sandboxed mode

**DOMPurify:**
Enabled by default for XSS protection. Customize via `dompurifyConfig` (use caution).

## Layout Algorithms

**dagre (default):**
Standard hierarchical layout for most diagrams.

**elk:**
Advanced layout with better handling of complex graphs.

**tidy-tree:**
Clean tree structures for hierarchies.

**cose-bilkent:**
Compound graph layout for nested structures.

**Per-diagram Configuration:**
````markdown
```mermaid
---
layout: elk
---
flowchart TD
  A --> B
```
````

## Common Patterns

**Consistent Hand-drawn Style:**
```javascript
mermaid.initialize({
  look: 'handDrawn',
  handDrawnSeed: 42  // Same seed = consistent appearance
});
```

**Dark Mode Toggle:**
```javascript
const isDark = window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches;
mermaid.initialize({
  theme: isDark ? 'dark' : 'default'
});
```

**Performance Optimization:**
```javascript
mermaid.initialize({
  startOnLoad: false,  // Manual rendering
  maxEdges: 1000,       // Increase for complex graphs
  deterministicIds: true  // Caching-friendly
});
```

## Validation

**Parse without Rendering:**
```javascript
try {
  await mermaid.parse('graph TD\nA-->B');
  console.log('Valid syntax');
} catch(e) {
  console.error('Invalid:', e);
}
```

**Programmatic Rendering:**
```javascript
const { svg } = await mermaid.render('graphId', 'graph TD\nA-->B');
document.getElementById('output').innerHTML = svg;
```

# Mermaid.js Configuration & Theming

Configuration options, theming, and customization for Mermaid.js v11.

## Configuration Methods

**1. Site-wide Initialization:**
```javascript
mermaid.initialize({
  theme: 'dark',
  startOnLoad: true,
  securityLevel: 'strict',
  fontFamily: 'Arial'
});
```

**2. Diagram-level Frontmatter:**
````markdown
```mermaid
---
theme: forest
look: handDrawn
---
flowchart TD
  A --> B
```
````

**3. Configuration Hierarchy:**
Default config → Site config → Diagram config (highest priority)

## Core Options

**Rendering:**
- `startOnLoad`: Auto-render on page load (default: true)
- `securityLevel`: "strict" (default), "loose", "antiscript", "sandbox"
- `deterministicIds`: Reproducible SVG IDs (default: false)
- `maxTextSize`: Max diagram text (default: 50000)
- `maxEdges`: Max drawable edges (default: 500)

**Visual Style:**
- `look`: "classic" (default), "handDrawn"
- `handDrawnSeed`: Numeric seed for hand-drawn consistency
- `darkMode`: Boolean toggle

**Typography:**
- `fontFamily`: "trebuchet ms, verdana, arial, sans-serif" (default)
- `fontSize`: Base text size (default: 16)

**Layout:**
- `layout`: "dagre" (default), "elk", "tidy-tree", "cose-bilkent"

**Debug:**
- `logLevel`: 0-5 from trace to fatal
- `htmlLabels`: Enable HTML in labels (default: false)

## Theming

**Built-in Themes:**
- `default` - Standard colors
- `dark` - Dark background
- `forest` - Green tones
- `neutral` - Grayscale
- `base` - Fully customizable

**Theme Variables (base theme only):**
```javascript
mermaid.initialize({
  theme: 'base',
  themeVariables: {
    primaryColor: '#ff0000',
    primaryTextColor: '#fff',
    primaryBorderColor: '#7C0000',
    secondaryColor: '#006100',
    tertiaryColor: '#fff'
  }
});
```

**Customizable Variables:**
- Color families: primary, secondary, tertiary
- Node backgrounds and text colors
- Border and line colors
- Note background/text
- Diagram-specific (flowchart nodes, sequence actors, pie sections)

**Custom CSS:**
```javascript
mermaid.initialize({
  themeCSS: `
    .node rect { fill: #f9f; }
    .edgeLabel { background-color: white; }
  `
});
```

## Accessibility

**ARIA Support:**
```
accTitle: Diagram Title
accDescr: Brief description
accDescr {
  Multi-line detailed
  description
}
```

**Auto-generated:**
- `aria-roledescription` attributes
- `<title>` and `<desc>` SVG elements
- `aria-labelledby` and `aria-describedby`

**WCAG Compliance:**
Available for all diagram types (flowchart, sequence, class, Gantt, etc.)

## Icon Configuration

**Register Icon Packs:**
```javascript
import { registerIconPacks } from 'mermaid';
registerIconPacks([
  {
    name: 'logos',
    loader: () => import('https://esm.run/@iconify-json/logos')
  }
]);
```

**Usage:**
```
architecture-beta
  service api(logos:nodejs)[API]
```

**Loading Methods:**
1. CDN-based (lazy loading)
2. npm with dynamic import
3. Direct import

## Math Rendering

**KaTeX Support:**
```
graph LR
  A["$$f(x) = x^2$$"] --> B
```

**Configuration:**
- `legacyMathML`: Use old MathML rendering
- `forceLegacyMathML`: Force legacy even if browser supports native

## Security

**Security Levels:**
- `strict` - HTML encoding (default, recommended)
- `loose` - Some HTML allowed
- `antiscript` - Filter scripts
- `sandbox` - Sandboxed mode

**DOMPurify:**
Enabled by default for XSS protection. Customize via `dompurifyConfig` (use caution).

## Layout Algorithms

**dagre (default):**
Standard hierarchical layout for most diagrams.

**elk:**
Advanced layout with better handling of complex graphs.

**tidy-tree:**
Clean tree structures for hierarchies.

**cose-bilkent:**
Compound graph layout for nested structures.

**Per-diagram Configuration:**
````markdown
```mermaid
---
layout: elk
---
flowchart TD
  A --> B
```
````

## Common Patterns

**Consistent Hand-drawn Style:**
```javascript
mermaid.initialize({
  look: 'handDrawn',
  handDrawnSeed: 42  // Same seed = consistent appearance
});
```

**Dark Mode Toggle:**
```javascript
const isDark = window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches;
mermaid.initialize({
  theme: isDark ? 'dark' : 'default'
});
```

**Performance Optimization:**
```javascript
mermaid.initialize({
  startOnLoad: false,  // Manual rendering
  maxEdges: 1000,       // Increase for complex graphs
  deterministicIds: true  // Caching-friendly
});
```

## Validation

**Parse without Rendering:**
```javascript
try {
  await mermaid.parse('graph TD\nA-->B');
  console.log('Valid syntax');
} catch(e) {
  console.error('Invalid:', e);
}
```

**Programmatic Rendering:**
```javascript
const { svg } = await mermaid.render('graphId', 'graph TD\nA-->B');
document.getElementById('output').innerHTML = svg;
```

1	# Mermaid.js Diagram Types
2	
3	Comprehensive syntax reference for all 24+ diagram types in Mermaid.js v11.
4	
5	## Core Diagrams
6	
7	### Flowchart
8	Process flows, decision trees, workflows.
9	
10	**Syntax:**
11	```
12	flowchart {direction}
13	  {nodeId}[{label}] {arrow} {nodeId}[{label}]
14	```
15	
16	**Directions:** TB/TD (top-bottom), BT, LR (left-right), RL
17	**Shapes:** `()` round, `[]` rect, `{}` diamond, `{{}}` hexagon, `(())` circle
18	**Arrows:** `-->` solid, `-.->` dotted, `==>` thick
19	**Subgraphs:** Group related nodes
20	
21	### Sequence Diagram
22	Actor interactions, API flows, message sequences.
23	
24	**Syntax:**
25	```
26	sequenceDiagram
27	  participant A as Actor
28	  A->>B: Message
29	  activate B
30	  B-->>A: Response
31	  deactivate B
32	```
33	
34	**Arrows:** `->` solid, `->>` arrow, `-->` dotted, `-x` cross, `-)` async
35	**Features:** Loops, alternatives, parallel, optional, critical regions
36	
37	### Class Diagram
38	OOP structures, inheritance, relationships.
39	
40	**Syntax:**
41	```
42	classDiagram
43	  class Animal {
44	    +String name
45	    -int age
46	    +void eat()
47	  }
48	  Animal <|-- Dog : inherits
49	```
50	
51	**Visibility:** `+` public, `-` private, `#` protected, `~` package
52	**Relationships:** `<|--` inheritance, `*--` composition, `o--` aggregation, `-->` association
53	
54	### State Diagram
55	State machines, transitions, workflows.
56	
57	**Syntax:**
58	```
59	stateDiagram-v2
60	  [*] --> State1
61	  State1 --> State2 : transition
62	  State2 --> [*]
63	```
64	
65	**Features:** Composite states, choice points, forks/joins, concurrency
66	
67	### ER Diagram
68	Database relationships, schemas.
69	
70	**Syntax:**
71	```
72	erDiagram
73	  CUSTOMER ||--o{ ORDER : places
74	  ORDER ||--|{ LINE_ITEM : contains
75	```
76	
77	**Cardinality:** `||` one, `|o` zero-one, `}|` one-many, `}o` zero-many
78	
79	## Planning Diagrams
80	
81	### Gantt Chart
82	Project timelines, schedules.
83	
84	**Syntax:**
85	```
86	gantt
87	  title Project
88	  dateFormat YYYY-MM-DD
89	  section Phase1
90	    Task1 :done, 2024-01-01, 5d
91	    Task2 :active, after Task1, 3d
92	```
93	
94	**Status:** `done`, `active`, `crit`, `milestone`
95	
96	### User Journey
97	Experience flows, satisfaction tracking.
98	
99	**Syntax:**
100	```
101	journey
102	  title User Journey
103	  section Shopping
104	    Browse: 5: Customer
105	    Add to cart: 3: Customer, System
106	```
107	
108	**Scores:** 1-5 satisfaction levels
109	
110	### Kanban
111	Task boards, workflow stages.
112	
113	**Syntax:**
114	```
115	kanban
116	  Todo[Task Board]
117	    task1[Implement API]
118	    @{ assigned: "Dev1", priority: "High" }
119	  InProgress[In Progress]
120	    task2[Fix bug]
121	```
122	
123	### Quadrant Chart
124	Prioritization, trend analysis.
125	
126	**Syntax:**
127	```
128	quadrantChart
129	  x-axis Low --> High
130	  y-axis Low --> High
131	  Item A: [0.3, 0.6]
132	```
133	
134	## Architecture Diagrams
135	
136	### C4 Diagram
137	System architecture, components.
138	
139	**Syntax:**
140	```
141	C4Context
142	  Person(user, "User")
143	  System(app, "Application")
144	  Rel(user, app, "Uses")
145	```
146	
147	### Architecture Diagram
148	Cloud infrastructure, services.
149	
150	**Syntax:**
151	```
152	architecture-beta
153	  service api(server)[API]
154	  service db(database)[Database]
155	  api:R --> L:db
156	```
157	
158	**Icons:** cloud, database, disk, internet, server, or iconify.design icons
159	
160	### Block Diagram
161	Module dependencies, networks.
162	
163	**Syntax:**
164	```
165	block-beta
166	  columns 3
167	  a["Block A"] b["Block B"]
168	  a --> b
169	```
170	
171	**Shapes:** rounded, stadium, cylinder, diamond, trapezoid, hexagon
172	
173	## Data Visualization
174	
175	### Pie Chart
176	Proportions, distributions.
177	
178	**Syntax:**
179	```
180	pie showData
181	  "Category A" : 45.5
182	  "Category B" : 30.0
183	```
184	
185	### XY Chart
186	Trends, comparisons.
187	
188	**Syntax:**
189	```
190	xychart-beta
191	  x-axis [jan, feb, mar]
192	  y-axis "Sales" 0 --> 100
193	  line [30, 45, 60]
194	  bar [25, 40, 55]
195	```
196	
197	### Sankey
198	Flow visualization, resource allocation.
199	
200	**Syntax:**
201	```
202	sankey-beta
203	  Source,Target,Value
204	  A,B,10
205	  B,C,5
206	```
207	
208	### Radar Chart
209	Multi-dimensional comparison.
210	
211	**Syntax:**
212	```
213	radar-beta
214	  axis Skill1, Skill2, Skill3
215	  curve Team1{3,4,5}
216	  curve Team2{4,3,4}
217	```
218	
219	### Treemap
220	Hierarchical proportions.
221	
222	**Syntax:**
223	```
224	treemap-beta
225	  "Root"
226	    "Category A"
227	      "Item 1": 100
228	      "Item 2": 200
229	```
230	
231	## Technical Diagrams
232	
233	### Git Graph
234	Branching strategies, workflows.
235	
236	**Syntax:**
237	```
238	gitGraph
239	  commit
240	  branch develop
241	  checkout develop
242	  commit
243	  checkout main
244	  merge develop
245	```
246	
247	### Timeline
248	Chronological events, milestones.
249	
250	**Syntax:**
251	```
252	timeline
253	  2024 : Event A : Event B
254	  2025 : Event C
255	```
256	
257	### Packet Diagram
258	Network protocols, structures.
259	
260	**Syntax:**
261	```
262	packet-beta
263	  0-15: "Header"
264	  16-31: "Data"
265	```
266	
267	### ZenUML Sequence
268	Alternative sequence syntax.
269	
270	**Syntax:**
271	```
272	zenuml
273	  A.method() {
274	    B.process()
275	    return result
276	  }
277	```
278	
279	### Mindmap
280	Brainstorming, hierarchies.
281	
282	**Syntax:**
283	```
284	mindmap
285	  root((Central Idea))
286	    Branch 1
287	      Sub 1
288	      Sub 2
289	    Branch 2
290	```
291	
292	### Requirement Diagram
293	SysML requirements, traceability.
294	
295	**Syntax:**
296	```
297	requirementDiagram
298	  requirement req1 {
299	    id: R1
300	    text: User shall login
301	    risk: Medium
302	  }
303	```
304	
305	## Quick Reference
306	
307	| Type | Best For | Complexity |
308	|------|----------|------------|
309	| Flowchart | Processes | Low |
310	| Sequence | Interactions | Medium |
311	| Class | OOP | High |
312	| State | Behaviors | Medium |
313	| ER | Databases | Low |
314	| Gantt | Timelines | Medium |
315	| Architecture | Systems | High |
316

# Mermaid.js Diagram Types

Comprehensive syntax reference for all 24+ diagram types in Mermaid.js v11.

## Core Diagrams

### Flowchart
Process flows, decision trees, workflows.

**Syntax:**
```
flowchart {direction}
  {nodeId}[{label}] {arrow} {nodeId}[{label}]
```

**Directions:** TB/TD (top-bottom), BT, LR (left-right), RL
**Shapes:** `()` round, `[]` rect, `{}` diamond, `{{}}` hexagon, `(())` circle
**Arrows:** `-->` solid, `-.->` dotted, `==>` thick
**Subgraphs:** Group related nodes

### Sequence Diagram
Actor interactions, API flows, message sequences.

**Syntax:**
```
sequenceDiagram
  participant A as Actor
  A->>B: Message
  activate B
  B-->>A: Response
  deactivate B
```

**Arrows:** `->` solid, `->>` arrow, `-->` dotted, `-x` cross, `-)` async
**Features:** Loops, alternatives, parallel, optional, critical regions

### Class Diagram
OOP structures, inheritance, relationships.

**Syntax:**
```
classDiagram
  class Animal {
    +String name
    -int age
    +void eat()
  }
  Animal <|-- Dog : inherits
```

**Visibility:** `+` public, `-` private, `#` protected, `~` package
**Relationships:** `<|--` inheritance, `*--` composition, `o--` aggregation, `-->` association

### State Diagram
State machines, transitions, workflows.

**Syntax:**
```
stateDiagram-v2
  [*] --> State1
  State1 --> State2 : transition
  State2 --> [*]
```

**Features:** Composite states, choice points, forks/joins, concurrency

### ER Diagram
Database relationships, schemas.

**Syntax:**
```
erDiagram
  CUSTOMER ||--o{ ORDER : places
  ORDER ||--|{ LINE_ITEM : contains
```

**Cardinality:** `||` one, `|o` zero-one, `}|` one-many, `}o` zero-many

## Planning Diagrams

### Gantt Chart
Project timelines, schedules.

**Syntax:**
```
gantt
  title Project
  dateFormat YYYY-MM-DD
  section Phase1
    Task1 :done, 2024-01-01, 5d
    Task2 :active, after Task1, 3d
```

**Status:** `done`, `active`, `crit`, `milestone`

### User Journey
Experience flows, satisfaction tracking.

**Syntax:**
```
journey
  title User Journey
  section Shopping
    Browse: 5: Customer
    Add to cart: 3: Customer, System
```

**Scores:** 1-5 satisfaction levels

### Kanban
Task boards, workflow stages.

**Syntax:**
```
kanban
  Todo[Task Board]
    task1[Implement API]
    @{ assigned: "Dev1", priority: "High" }
  InProgress[In Progress]
    task2[Fix bug]
```

### Quadrant Chart
Prioritization, trend analysis.

**Syntax:**
```
quadrantChart
  x-axis Low --> High
  y-axis Low --> High
  Item A: [0.3, 0.6]
```

## Architecture Diagrams

### C4 Diagram
System architecture, components.

**Syntax:**
```
C4Context
  Person(user, "User")
  System(app, "Application")
  Rel(user, app, "Uses")
```

### Architecture Diagram
Cloud infrastructure, services.

**Syntax:**
```
architecture-beta
  service api(server)[API]
  service db(database)[Database]
  api:R --> L:db
```

**Icons:** cloud, database, disk, internet, server, or iconify.design icons

### Block Diagram
Module dependencies, networks.

**Syntax:**
```
block-beta
  columns 3
  a["Block A"] b["Block B"]
  a --> b
```

**Shapes:** rounded, stadium, cylinder, diamond, trapezoid, hexagon

## Data Visualization

### Pie Chart
Proportions, distributions.

**Syntax:**
```
pie showData
  "Category A" : 45.5
  "Category B" : 30.0
```

### XY Chart
Trends, comparisons.

**Syntax:**
```
xychart-beta
  x-axis [jan, feb, mar]
  y-axis "Sales" 0 --> 100
  line [30, 45, 60]
  bar [25, 40, 55]
```

### Sankey
Flow visualization, resource allocation.

**Syntax:**
```
sankey-beta
  Source,Target,Value
  A,B,10
  B,C,5
```

### Radar Chart
Multi-dimensional comparison.

**Syntax:**
```
radar-beta
  axis Skill1, Skill2, Skill3
  curve Team1{3,4,5}
  curve Team2{4,3,4}
```

### Treemap
Hierarchical proportions.

**Syntax:**
```
treemap-beta
  "Root"
    "Category A"
      "Item 1": 100
      "Item 2": 200
```

## Technical Diagrams

### Git Graph
Branching strategies, workflows.

**Syntax:**
```
gitGraph
  commit
  branch develop
  checkout develop
  commit
  checkout main
  merge develop
```

### Timeline
Chronological events, milestones.

**Syntax:**
```
timeline
  2024 : Event A : Event B
  2025 : Event C
```

### Packet Diagram
Network protocols, structures.

**Syntax:**
```
packet-beta
  0-15: "Header"
  16-31: "Data"
```

### ZenUML Sequence
Alternative sequence syntax.

**Syntax:**
```
zenuml
  A.method() {
    B.process()
    return result
  }
```

### Mindmap
Brainstorming, hierarchies.

**Syntax:**
```
mindmap
  root((Central Idea))
    Branch 1
      Sub 1
      Sub 2
    Branch 2
```

### Requirement Diagram
SysML requirements, traceability.

**Syntax:**
```
requirementDiagram
  requirement req1 {
    id: R1
    text: User shall login
    risk: Medium
  }
```

## Quick Reference

| Type | Best For | Complexity |
|------|----------|------------|
| Flowchart | Processes | Low |
| Sequence | Interactions | Medium |
| Class | OOP | High |
| State | Behaviors | Medium |
| ER | Databases | Low |
| Gantt | Timelines | Medium |
| Architecture | Systems | High |

40	**Syntax:**
41	```
42	classDiagram
43	  class Animal {
44	    +String name
45	    -int age
46	    +void eat()
47	  }
48	  Animal <|-- Dog : inherits
49	```
50	
51	**Visibility:** `+` public, `-` private, `#` protected, `~` package
52	**Relationships:** `<|--` inheritance, `*--` composition, `o--` aggregation, `-->` association
53	
54	### State Diagram
55	State machines, transitions, workflows.
56	
57	**Syntax:**
58	```
59	stateDiagram-v2
60	  [*] --> State1
61	  State1 --> State2 : transition
62	  State2 --> [*]
63	```
64	
65	**Features:** Composite states, choice points, forks/joins, concurrency
66	
67	### ER Diagram
68	Database relationships, schemas.
69	
70	**Syntax:**
71	```
72	erDiagram
73	  CUSTOMER ||--o{ ORDER : places
74	  ORDER ||--|{ LINE_ITEM : contains
75	```
76	
77	**Cardinality:** `||` one, `|o` zero-one, `}|` one-many, `}o` zero-many
78	
79	## Planning Diagrams
80	
81	### Gantt Chart
82	Project timelines, schedules.
83	
84	**Syntax:**
85	```
86	gantt
87	  title Project
88	  dateFormat YYYY-MM-DD
89	  section Phase1
90	    Task1 :done, 2024-01-01, 5d
91	    Task2 :active, after Task1, 3d
92	```
93	
94	**Status:** `done`, `active`, `crit`, `milestone`
95	
96	### User Journey
97	Experience flows, satisfaction tracking.
98	
99	**Syntax:**
100	```
101	journey
102	  title User Journey
103	  section Shopping
104	    Browse: 5: Customer
105	    Add to cart: 3: Customer, System
106	```
107	
108	**Scores:** 1-5 satisfaction levels
109	
110	### Kanban
111	Task boards, workflow stages.
112	
113	**Syntax:**
114	```
115	kanban
116	  Todo[Task Board]
117	    task1[Implement API]
118	    @{ assigned: "Dev1", priority: "High" }
119	  InProgress[In Progress]
120	    task2[Fix bug]
121	```
122	
123	### Quadrant Chart
124	Prioritization, trend analysis.
125	
126	**Syntax:**
127	```
128	quadrantChart
129	  x-axis Low --> High
130	  y-axis Low --> High
131	  Item A: [0.3, 0.6]
132	```
133	
134	## Architecture Diagrams
135	
136	### C4 Diagram
137	System architecture, components.
138	
139	**Syntax:**
140	```
141	C4Context
142	  Person(user, "User")
143	  System(app, "Application")
144	  Rel(user, app, "Uses")
145	```
146	
147	### Architecture Diagram
148	Cloud infrastructure, services.
149	
150	**Syntax:**
151	```
152	architecture-beta
153	  service api(server)[API]
154	  service db(database)[Database]
155	  api:R --> L:db
156	```
157	
158	**Icons:** cloud, database, disk, internet, server, or iconify.design icons
159	
160	### Block Diagram
161	Module dependencies, networks.
162	
163	**Syntax:**
164	```
165	block-beta
166	  columns 3
167	  a["Block A"] b["Block B"]
168	  a --> b
169	```
170	
171	**Shapes:** rounded, stadium, cylinder, diamond, trapezoid, hexagon
172	
173	## Data Visualization
174	
175	### Pie Chart
176	Proportions, distributions.
177	
178	**Syntax:**
179	```
180	pie showData
181	  "Category A" : 45.5
182	  "Category B" : 30.0
183	```
184	
185	### XY Chart
186	Trends, comparisons.
187	
188	**Syntax:**
189	```
190	xychart-beta
191	  x-axis [jan, feb, mar]
192	  y-axis "Sales" 0 --> 100
193	  line [30, 45, 60]
194	  bar [25, 40, 55]
195	```
196	
197	### Sankey
198	Flow visualization, resource allocation.
199	
200	**Syntax:**
201	```
202	sankey-beta
203	  Source,Target,Value
204	  A,B,10
205	  B,C,5
206	```
207	
208	### Radar Chart
209	Multi-dimensional comparison.
210	
211	**Syntax:**
212	```
213	radar-beta
214	  axis Skill1, Skill2, Skill3
215	  curve Team1{3,4,5}
216	  curve Team2{4,3,4}
217	```
218	
219	### Treemap
220	Hierarchical proportions.
221	
222	**Syntax:**
223	```
224	treemap-beta
225	  "Root"
226	    "Category A"
227	      "Item 1": 100
228	      "Item 2": 200
229	```
230	
231	## Technical Diagrams
232	
233	### Git Graph
234	Branching strategies, workflows.
235	
236	**Syntax:**
237	```
238	gitGraph
239	  commit
240	  branch develop
241	  checkout develop
242	  commit
243	  checkout main
244	  merge develop
245	```
246	
247	### Timeline
248	Chronological events, milestones.
249	
250	**Syntax:**
251	```
252	timeline
253	  2024 : Event A : Event B
254	  2025 : Event C
255	```
256	
257	### Packet Diagram
258	Network protocols, structures.
259	
260	**Syntax:**
261	```
262	packet-beta
263	  0-15: "Header"
264	  16-31: "Data"
265	```
266	
267	### ZenUML Sequence
268	Alternative sequence syntax.
269	
270	**Syntax:**
271	```
272	zenuml
273	  A.method() {
274	    B.process()
275	    return result
276	  }
277	```
278	
279	### Mindmap
280	Brainstorming, hierarchies.
281	
282	**Syntax:**
283	```
284	mindmap
285	  root((Central Idea))
286	    Branch 1
287	      Sub 1
288	      Sub 2
289	    Branch 2
290	```
291	
292	### Requirement Diagram
293	SysML requirements, traceability.
294	
295	**Syntax:**
296	```
297	requirementDiagram
298	  requirement req1 {
299	    id: R1
300	    text: User shall login
301	    risk: Medium
302	  }
303	```
304	
305	## Quick Reference
306	
307	| Type | Best For | Complexity |
308	|------|----------|------------|
309	| Flowchart | Processes | Low |
310	| Sequence | Interactions | Medium |
311	| Class | OOP | High |
312	| State | Behaviors | Medium |
313	| ER | Databases | Low |
314	| Gantt | Timelines | Medium |

10	```
11	
12	**Local Install:**

16	```

18	**No Install (npx):**

21	```
22	
23	**Docker:**
24	```bash
25	docker pull ghcr.io/mermaid-js/mermaid-cli/mermaid-cli
26	```
27	
28	**Requirements:** Node.js ^18.19 || >=20.0
29	
30	## Basic Commands
31	
32	**Convert to SVG:**
33	```bash
34	mmdc -i input.mmd -o output.svg
35	```
36	
37	**Convert to PNG:**
38	```bash
39	mmdc -i input.mmd -o output.png
40	```
41	
42	**Convert to PDF:**
43	```bash
44	mmdc -i input.mmd -o output.pdf
45	```
46	
47	Output format determined by file extension.
48	
49	## CLI Flags
50	
51	**Core Options:**
52	- `-i, --input <file>` - Input file (use `-` for stdin)
53	- `-o, --output <file>` - Output file path
54	- `-t, --theme <name>` - Theme: default, dark, forest, neutral
55	- `-b, --background <color>` - Background: transparent, white, #hex
56	- `--cssFile <file>` - Custom CSS for styling
57	- `--configFile <file>` - Mermaid configuration file
58	- `-h, --help` - Show all options
59	
60	**Example with All Options:**
61	```bash
62	mmdc -i diagram.mmd -o output.png \
63	  -t dark \
64	  -b transparent \
65	  --cssFile custom.css \
66	  --configFile mermaid-config.json
67	```
68	
69	## Advanced Usage
70	
71	**Stdin Piping:**
72	```bash
73	cat diagram.mmd | mmdc --input - -o output.svg
74	
75	# Or inline
76	cat << EOF | mmdc --input - -o output.svg
77	graph TD
78	  A[Start] --> B[End]
79	EOF
80	```
81	
82	**Batch Processing:**
83	```bash
84	for file in *.mmd; do
85	  mmdc -i "$file" -o "${file%.mmd}.svg"
86	done
87	```
88	
89	**Markdown Files:**
90	Process markdown with embedded diagrams:
91	```bash
92	mmdc -i README.template.md -o README.md
93	```
94	
95	## Docker Workflows
96	
97	**Basic Docker Usage:**
98	```bash
99	docker run --rm \
100	  -u $(id -u):$(id -g) \
101	  -v /path/to/diagrams:/data \
102	  ghcr.io/mermaid-js/mermaid-cli/mermaid-cli \
103	  -i diagram.mmd -o output.svg
104	```
105	
106	**Mount Working Directory:**
107	```bash
108	docker run --rm -v $(pwd):/data \
109	  ghcr.io/mermaid-js/mermaid-cli/mermaid-cli \
110	  -i /data/input.mmd -o /data/output.png
111	```
112	
113	**Podman (with SELinux):**
114	```bash
115	podman run --userns keep-id --user ${UID} \
116	  --rm -v /path/to/diagrams:/data:z \
117	  ghcr.io/mermaid-js/mermaid-cli/mermaid-cli \
118	  -i diagram.mmd
119	```
120	
121	## Configuration Files
122	
123	**Mermaid Config (JSON):**
124	```json
125	{
126	  "theme": "dark",
127	  "look": "handDrawn",
128	  "fontFamily": "Arial",
129	  "flowchart": {
130	    "curve": "basis"
131	  }
132	}
133	```
134	
135	**Usage:**
136	```bash
137	mmdc -i input.mmd --configFile config.json -o output.svg
138	```
139	
140	**Custom CSS:**
141	```css
142	.node rect {
143	  fill: #f9f;
144	  stroke: #333;
145	}
146	.edgeLabel {
147	  background-color: white;
148	}
149	```
150	
151	**Usage:**
152	```bash
153	mmdc -i input.mmd --cssFile styles.css -o output.svg
154	```
155	
156	## Node.js API
157	
158	**Programmatic Usage:**
159	```javascript
160	import { run } from '@mermaid-js/mermaid-cli';
161	
162	await run('input.mmd', 'output.svg', {
163	  theme: 'dark',
164	  backgroundColor: 'transparent'
165	});
166	```
167	
168	**With Options:**
169	```javascript
170	import { run } from '@mermaid-js/mermaid-cli';
171	
172	await run('diagram.mmd', 'output.png', {
173	  theme: 'forest',
174	  backgroundColor: '#ffffff',
175	  cssFile: 'custom.css',
176	  configFile: 'config.json'
177	});
178	```
179	
180	## Common Workflows
181	
182	**Documentation Generation:**
183	```bash
184	# Convert all diagrams in docs/
185	find docs/ -name "*.mmd" -exec sh -c \
186	  'mmdc -i "$1" -o "${1%.mmd}.svg"' _ {} \;
187	```
188	
189	**Styled Output:**
190	```bash
191	# Create dark-themed transparent diagrams
192	mmdc -i architecture.mmd -o arch.png \
193	  -t dark \
194	  -b transparent \
195	  --cssFile animations.css
196	```
197	
198	**CI/CD Pipeline:**
199	```yaml
200	# GitHub Actions example
201	- name: Generate Diagrams
202	  run: |
203	    npm install -g @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli
204	    mmdc -i docs/diagram.mmd -o docs/diagram.svg
205	```
206	
207	**Accessibility-Enhanced:**
208	```bash
209	# Diagrams with accTitle/accDescr preserved
210	mmdc -i accessible-diagram.mmd -o output.svg
211	```
212	
213	## Troubleshooting
214	
215	**Permission Issues (Docker):**
216	Use `-u $(id -u):$(id -g)` to match host user permissions.
217	
218	**Large Diagrams:**
219	Increase Node.js memory:
220	```bash
221	NODE_OPTIONS="--max-old-space-size=4096" mmdc -i large.mmd -o out.svg
222	```
223	
224	**Validation:**
225	Check syntax before rendering:
226	```bash
227	mmdc -i diagram.mmd -o /dev/null || echo "Invalid syntax"
228	```

# Mermaid.js CLI Usage

Command-line interface for converting Mermaid diagrams to SVG/PNG/PDF.

## Installation

**Global Install:**
```bash
npm install -g @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli
```

**Local Install:**
```bash
npm install @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli
./node_modules/.bin/mmdc -h
```

**No Install (npx):**
```bash
npx -p @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli mmdc -h
```

**Docker:**
```bash
docker pull ghcr.io/mermaid-js/mermaid-cli/mermaid-cli
```

**Requirements:** Node.js ^18.19 || >=20.0

## Basic Commands

**Convert to SVG:**
```bash
mmdc -i input.mmd -o output.svg
```

**Convert to PNG:**
```bash
mmdc -i input.mmd -o output.png
```

**Convert to PDF:**
```bash
mmdc -i input.mmd -o output.pdf
```

Output format determined by file extension.

## CLI Flags

**Core Options:**
- `-i, --input <file>` - Input file (use `-` for stdin)
- `-o, --output <file>` - Output file path
- `-t, --theme <name>` - Theme: default, dark, forest, neutral
- `-b, --background <color>` - Background: transparent, white, #hex
- `--cssFile <file>` - Custom CSS for styling
- `--configFile <file>` - Mermaid configuration file
- `-h, --help` - Show all options

**Example with All Options:**
```bash
mmdc -i diagram.mmd -o output.png \
  -t dark \
  -b transparent \
  --cssFile custom.css \
  --configFile mermaid-config.json
```

## Advanced Usage

**Stdin Piping:**
```bash
cat diagram.mmd | mmdc --input - -o output.svg

# Or inline
cat << EOF | mmdc --input - -o output.svg
graph TD
  A[Start] --> B[End]
EOF
```

**Batch Processing:**
```bash
for file in *.mmd; do
  mmdc -i "$file" -o "${file%.mmd}.svg"
done
```

**Markdown Files:**
Process markdown with embedded diagrams:
```bash
mmdc -i README.template.md -o README.md
```

## Docker Workflows

**Basic Docker Usage:**
```bash
docker run --rm \
  -u $(id -u):$(id -g) \
  -v /path/to/diagrams:/data \
  ghcr.io/mermaid-js/mermaid-cli/mermaid-cli \
  -i diagram.mmd -o output.svg
```

**Mount Working Directory:**
```bash
docker run --rm -v $(pwd):/data \
  ghcr.io/mermaid-js/mermaid-cli/mermaid-cli \
  -i /data/input.mmd -o /data/output.png
```

**Podman (with SELinux):**
```bash
podman run --userns keep-id --user ${UID} \
  --rm -v /path/to/diagrams:/data:z \
  ghcr.io/mermaid-js/mermaid-cli/mermaid-cli \
  -i diagram.mmd
```

## Configuration Files

**Mermaid Config (JSON):**
```json
{
  "theme": "dark",
  "look": "handDrawn",
  "fontFamily": "Arial",
  "flowchart": {
    "curve": "basis"
  }
}
```

**Usage:**
```bash
mmdc -i input.mmd --configFile config.json -o output.svg
```

**Custom CSS:**
```css
.node rect {
  fill: #f9f;
  stroke: #333;
}
.edgeLabel {
  background-color: white;
}
```

**Usage:**
```bash
mmdc -i input.mmd --cssFile styles.css -o output.svg
```

## Node.js API

**Programmatic Usage:**
```javascript
import { run } from '@mermaid-js/mermaid-cli';

await run('input.mmd', 'output.svg', {
  theme: 'dark',
  backgroundColor: 'transparent'
});
```

**With Options:**
```javascript
import { run } from '@mermaid-js/mermaid-cli';

await run('diagram.mmd', 'output.png', {
  theme: 'forest',
  backgroundColor: '#ffffff',
  cssFile: 'custom.css',
  configFile: 'config.json'
});
```

## Common Workflows

**Documentation Generation:**
```bash
# Convert all diagrams in docs/
find docs/ -name "*.mmd" -exec sh -c \
  'mmdc -i "$1" -o "${1%.mmd}.svg"' _ {} \;
```

**Styled Output:**
```bash
# Create dark-themed transparent diagrams
mmdc -i architecture.mmd -o arch.png \
  -t dark \
  -b transparent \
  --cssFile animations.css
```

**CI/CD Pipeline:**
```yaml
# GitHub Actions example
- name: Generate Diagrams
  run: |
    npm install -g @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli
    mmdc -i docs/diagram.mmd -o docs/diagram.svg
```

**Accessibility-Enhanced:**
```bash
# Diagrams with accTitle/accDescr preserved
mmdc -i accessible-diagram.mmd -o output.svg
```

## Troubleshooting

**Permission Issues (Docker):**
Use `-u $(id -u):$(id -g)` to match host user permissions.

**Large Diagrams:**
Increase Node.js memory:
```bash
NODE_OPTIONS="--max-old-space-size=4096" mmdc -i large.mmd -o out.svg
```

**Validation:**
Check syntax before rendering:
```bash
mmdc -i diagram.mmd -o /dev/null || echo "Invalid syntax"
```

# Mermaid.js CLI Usage

Command-line interface for converting Mermaid diagrams to SVG/PNG/PDF.

## Installation

**Global Install:**
```bash
npm install -g @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli
```

**Local Install:**
```bash
npm install @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli
./node_modules/.bin/mmdc -h
```

**No Install (npx):**
```bash
npx -p @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli mmdc -h
```

**Docker:**
```bash
docker pull ghcr.io/mermaid-js/mermaid-cli/mermaid-cli
```

**Requirements:** Node.js ^18.19 || >=20.0

## Basic Commands

**Convert to SVG:**
```bash
mmdc -i input.mmd -o output.svg
```

**Convert to PNG:**
```bash
mmdc -i input.mmd -o output.png
```

**Convert to PDF:**
```bash
mmdc -i input.mmd -o output.pdf
```

Output format determined by file extension.

## CLI Flags

**Core Options:**
- `-i, --input <file>` - Input file (use `-` for stdin)
- `-o, --output <file>` - Output file path
- `-t, --theme <name>` - Theme: default, dark, forest, neutral
- `-b, --background <color>` - Background: transparent, white, #hex
- `--cssFile <file>` - Custom CSS for styling
- `--configFile <file>` - Mermaid configuration file
- `-h, --help` - Show all options

**Example with All Options:**
```bash
mmdc -i diagram.mmd -o output.png \
  -t dark \
  -b transparent \
  --cssFile custom.css \
  --configFile mermaid-config.json
```

## Advanced Usage

**Stdin Piping:**
```bash
cat diagram.mmd | mmdc --input - -o output.svg

# Or inline
cat << EOF | mmdc --input - -o output.svg
graph TD
  A[Start] --> B[End]
EOF
```

**Batch Processing:**
```bash
for file in *.mmd; do
  mmdc -i "$file" -o "${file%.mmd}.svg"
done
```

**Markdown Files:**
Process markdown with embedded diagrams:
```bash
mmdc -i README.template.md -o README.md
```

## Docker Workflows

**Basic Docker Usage:**
```bash
docker run --rm \
  -u $(id -u):$(id -g) \
  -v /path/to/diagrams:/data \
  ghcr.io/mermaid-js/mermaid-cli/mermaid-cli \
  -i diagram.mmd -o output.svg
```

**Mount Working Directory:**
```bash
docker run --rm -v $(pwd):/data \
  ghcr.io/mermaid-js/mermaid-cli/mermaid-cli \
  -i /data/input.mmd -o /data/output.png
```

**Podman (with SELinux):**
```bash
podman run --userns keep-id --user ${UID} \
  --rm -v /path/to/diagrams:/data:z \
  ghcr.io/mermaid-js/mermaid-cli/mermaid-cli \
  -i diagram.mmd
```

## Configuration Files

**Mermaid Config (JSON):**
```json
{
  "theme": "dark",
  "look": "handDrawn",
  "fontFamily": "Arial",
  "flowchart": {
    "curve": "basis"
  }
}
```

**Usage:**
```bash
mmdc -i input.mmd --configFile config.json -o output.svg
```

**Custom CSS:**
```css
.node rect {
  fill: #f9f;
  stroke: #333;
}
.edgeLabel {
  background-color: white;
}
```

**Usage:**
```bash
mmdc -i input.mmd --cssFile styles.css -o output.svg
```

## Node.js API

**Programmatic Usage:**
```javascript
import { run } from '@mermaid-js/mermaid-cli';

await run('input.mmd', 'output.svg', {
  theme: 'dark',
  backgroundColor: 'transparent'
});
```

**With Options:**
```javascript
import { run } from '@mermaid-js/mermaid-cli';

await run('diagram.mmd', 'output.png', {
  theme: 'forest',
  backgroundColor: '#ffffff',
  cssFile: 'custom.css',
  configFile: 'config.json'
});
```

## Common Workflows

**Documentation Generation:**
```bash
# Convert all diagrams in docs/
find docs/ -name "*.mmd" -exec sh -c \
  'mmdc -i "$1" -o "${1%.mmd}.svg"' _ {} \;
```

**Styled Output:**
```bash
# Create dark-themed transparent diagrams
mmdc -i architecture.mmd -o arch.png \
  -t dark \
  -b transparent \
  --cssFile animations.css
```

**CI/CD Pipeline:**
```yaml
# GitHub Actions example
- name: Generate Diagrams
  run: |
    npm install -g @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli
    mmdc -i docs/diagram.mmd -o docs/diagram.svg
```

**Accessibility-Enhanced:**
```bash
# Diagrams with accTitle/accDescr preserved
mmdc -i accessible-diagram.mmd -o output.svg
```

## Troubleshooting

**Permission Issues (Docker):**
Use `-u $(id -u):$(id -g)` to match host user permissions.

**Large Diagrams:**
Increase Node.js memory:
```bash
NODE_OPTIONS="--max-old-space-size=4096" mmdc -i large.mmd -o out.svg
```

**Validation:**
Check syntax before rendering:
```bash
mmdc -i diagram.mmd -o /dev/null || echo "Invalid syntax"
```

import json
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.lines import Line2D
import numpy as np
from datetime import datetime

# Load data
with open('/app/benchmark/source_data.json') as f:
    data = json.load(f)

# --- Color scheme (editorial) ---
C_RESEARCH = '#2563eb'
C_INDUSTRY = '#059669'
C_REGULATION = '#d97706'
C_INVESTMENT = '#6366f1'
C_CHATGPT = '#dc2626'
C_BG = '#fafaf8'
C_TEXT = '#1e293b'
C_GRID = '#e2e8f0'
C_ANNOTATION = '#475569'

# --- Figure setup ---
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(22, 18), facecolor=C_BG)
gs = fig.add_gridspec(2, 1, height_ratios=[3, 1], hspace=0.08)

ax_timeline = fig.add_subplot(gs[0])
ax_invest = fig.add_subplot(gs[1])

# --- Helper: parse date string to ordinal ---
def parse_date(d):
    if '-' in d:
        return datetime.strptime(d, '%Y-%m').toordinal()
    else:
        return datetime(int(d), 7, 1).toordinal()

# --- Prepare timeline data ---
tracks = []
for track_key, label, color in [
    ('research_milestones', 'Research', C_RESEARCH),
    ('industry_milestones', 'Industry', C_INDUSTRY),
    ('regulation_milestones', 'Regulation', C_REGULATION),
]:
    events = []
    for e in data[track_key]['data']:
        events.append({
            'date': parse_date(e['date']),
            'label': e['label'],
            'significance': e['significance'],
            'track': label,
            'color': color,
        })
    tracks.append((label, color, events))

# --- Timeline plot ---
y_positions = {'Research': 2, 'Industry': 1, 'Regulation': 0}
size_map = {'critical': 180, 'high': 100, 'medium': 55}
zorder_map = {'critical': 10, 'high': 7, 'medium': 5}
alpha_map = {'critical': 1.0, 'high': 0.85, 'medium': 0.65}

# Track background bands
for label, color, events in tracks:
    y = y_positions[label]
    ax_timeline.axhspan(y - 0.35, y + 0.35, facecolor=color, alpha=0.06, zorder=0)
    ax_timeline.axhline(y, color=color, alpha=0.15, linewidth=1, zorder=1)

# Plot events
all_scatters = []
event_positions = []  # store (date, y, label) for overlap avoidance

for label, color, events in tracks:
    y = y_positions[label]
    for e in events:
        sz = size_map[e['significance']]
        zo = zorder_map[e['significance']]
        al = alpha_map[e['significance']]
        ax_timeline.scatter(e['date'], y, s=sz, c=color, zorder=zo,
                          alpha=al, edgecolors='white', linewidth=1.2)
        event_positions.append((e['date'], y, e['label'], e['significance'], color))

# --- Smart label placement ---
# Sort events by date
event_positions.sort(key=lambda x: x[0])

# Place labels with offset alternation to reduce overlap
placed_labels = []  # (date, y, label_y_offset)
label_offsets = {}

for i, (d, y, lbl, sig, color) in enumerate(event_positions):
    # Check for nearby labels
    offset = 0.48
    # Alternate above/below to minimize overlap
    alt = 1 if i % 2 == 0 else -1
    actual_offset = offset * alt

    # For critical events, place more prominently
    if sig == 'critical':
        actual_offset = offset * alt * 1.0

    # Check proximity to other placed labels
    too_close = False
    for pd_, py_, poff in placed_labels:
        if abs(d - pd_) < 250 and abs((y + actual_offset) - (py_ + poff)) < 0.25:
            too_close = True
            break

    if too_close:
        actual_offset = -actual_offset
        # Check again
        still_close = False
        for pd_, py_, poff in placed_labels:
            if abs(d - pd_) < 250 and abs((y + actual_offset) - (py_ + poff)) < 0.25:
                still_close = True
                break
        if still_close:
            actual_offset = offset * alt * 1.4

    placed_labels.append((d, y, actual_offset))

    fontweight = 'bold' if sig == 'critical' else 'normal'
    fontsize = 8.5 if sig == 'critical' else 7.5

    ha = 'center'
    # Shift alignment for edge dates
    if d < parse_date('2013-01'):
        ha = 'left'
    elif d > parse_date('2024-06'):
        ha = 'right'

    ax_timeline.annotate(lbl, (d, y),
                        xytext=(0, actual_offset * 45),
                        textcoords='offset points',
                        fontsize=fontsize, fontweight=fontweight,
                        color=color, ha=ha, va='center',
                        fontfamily='serif')

# --- ChatGPT inflection line ---
chatgpt_date = parse_date('2022-11')
ax_timeline.axvline(chatgpt_date, color=C_CHATGPT, linewidth=2,
                   linestyle='--', alpha=0.7, zorder=2)
ax_timeline.annotate('ChatGPT\nNov 2022',
                    xy=(chatgpt_date, 2.6),
                    fontsize=10, fontweight='bold', color=C_CHATGPT,
                    ha='center', va='bottom', fontfamily='serif',
                    bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', facecolor='white',
                            edgecolor=C_CHATGPT, alpha=0.9))

# --- Lag arrows (Research → Industry → Regulation) ---
# Transformer (2017-06) to ChatGPT (2022-11) = 5.4yr
transformer_date = parse_date('2017-06')
ax_timeline.annotate('', xy=(chatgpt_date, 1.35), xytext=(transformer_date, 1.35),
                    arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='<->', color=C_ANNOTATION,
                                  lw=1.5, connectionstyle='arc3,rad=0'))
mid_tc = transformer_date + (chatgpt_date - transformer_date) / 2
ax_timeline.text(mid_tc, 1.55, '5.4 years\nResearch → Industry',
                fontsize=7.5, color=C_ANNOTATION, ha='center', va='bottom',
                fontfamily='serif', fontstyle='italic')

# ChatGPT (2022-11) to EU AI Act agreed (2023-05) = 0.5yr (shorter than 1.3yr to enacted)
eu_act_agreed = parse_date('2023-05')
biden_eo = parse_date('2023-10')
ax_timeline.annotate('', xy=(biden_eo, 0.45), xytext=(chatgpt_date, 0.45),
                    arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='<->', color=C_ANNOTATION,
                                  lw=1.5, connectionstyle='arc3,rad=0'))
mid_cb = chatgpt_date + (biden_eo - chatgpt_date) / 2
ax_timeline.text(mid_cb, 0.28, '11 months\nIndustry → Regulation',
                fontsize=7.5, color=C_ANNOTATION, ha='center', va='top',
                fontfamily='serif', fontstyle='italic')

# --- Highlight density zone (2023-2024) ---
density_start = parse_date('2023-01')
density_end = parse_date('2025-01')
ax_timeline.axvspan(density_start, density_end, facecolor=C_CHATGPT, alpha=0.04, zorder=0)
ax_timeline.text(density_start + (density_end - density_start) / 2, 2.75,
                'Acceleration Zone\n2023–2024', fontsize=9, color=C_CHATGPT,
                ha='center', va='top', fontfamily='serif', fontweight='bold',
                alpha=0.7)

# --- Timeline axis formatting ---
year_ords = [datetime(y, 1, 1).toordinal() for y in range(2010, 2027)]
year_labels = [str(y) for y in range(2010, 2027)]
ax_timeline.set_xlim(datetime(2009, 6, 1).toordinal(), datetime(2026, 2, 1).toordinal())
ax_timeline.set_xticks(year_ords)
ax_timeline.set_xticklabels(year_labels, fontfamily='serif', fontsize=11, color=C_TEXT)
ax_timeline.set_ylim(-0.7, 2.9)
ax_timeline.set_yticks([0, 1, 2])
ax_timeline.set_yticklabels(['Regulation', 'Industry', 'Research'],
                           fontfamily='serif', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold',
                           color=C_TEXT)
ax_timeline.tick_params(axis='y', length=0)
ax_timeline.tick_params(axis='x', length=4, colors=C_TEXT, pad=8)

# Grid
ax_timeline.set_axisbelow(True)
ax_timeline.yaxis.grid(True, alpha=0.3, color=C_GRID, linewidth=0.8)
ax_timeline.xaxis.grid(True, alpha=0.15, color=C_GRID, linewidth=0.5)

# Remove spines
for spine in ax_timeline.spines.values():
    spine.set_visible(False)

# --- Legend for significance ---
legend_elements = [
    Line2D([0], [0], marker='o', color='w', markerfacecolor='#64748b',
           markersize=14, label='Critical', markeredgecolor='white', markeredgewidth=1),
    Line2D([0], [0], marker='o', color='w', markerfacecolor='#64748b',
           markersize=10, label='High', markeredgecolor='white', markeredgewidth=1),
    Line2D([0], [0], marker='o', color='w', markerfacecolor='#64748b',

]

investments = [d['investment'] for d in inv_data]

# Value labels on bars

                      fontfamily='serif')

# Investment annotation
ax_invest.annotate('Investment doubled\n$48B → $95.8B (2022→2024)',

                  fontsize=10, fontweight='bold', color=C_INVESTMENT,

                  arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=C_INVESTMENT,

                  bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.4', facecolor='white',
                          edgecolor=C_INVESTMENT, alpha=0.9))

# Investment axis styling
ax_invest.set_xlim(2009.2, 2025.8)
ax_invest.set_xticks(range(2010, 2026))
ax_invest.set_xticklabels([str(y) for y in range(2010, 2026)],

ax_invest.set_ylim(0, 142)
ax_invest.tick_params(axis='y', labelsize=9, colors=C_TEXT)
ax_invest.tick_params(axis='x', length=4, colors=C_TEXT, pad=8)
ax_invest.set_axisbelow(True)
ax_invest.yaxis.grid(True, alpha=0.2, color=C_GRID, linewidth=0.5)
ax_invest.xaxis.grid(False)

for spine in ax_invest.spines.values():

# Add subplot labels
ax_timeline.text(0.008, 0.97, 'A', transform=ax_timeline.transAxes,

              fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', fontfamily='serif',
              color=C_TEXT, va='top')

# --- Suptitle ---
fig.suptitle('The AI Acceleration: From Research Breakthroughs to Global Regulation',

# Subtitle
fig.text(0.5, 0.955,

fig.text(0.5, 0.01,

import json
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.lines import Line2D
import numpy as np
from datetime import datetime

# Load data
with open('/app/benchmark/source_data.json') as f:
    data = json.load(f)

# --- Color scheme (editorial) ---
C_RESEARCH = '#2563eb'
C_INDUSTRY = '#059669'
C_REGULATION = '#d97706'
C_INVESTMENT = '#6366f1'
C_CHATGPT = '#dc2626'
C_BG = '#fafaf8'
C_TEXT = '#1e293b'
C_GRID = '#e2e8f0'
C_ANNOTATION = '#64748b'

# --- Figure setup with constrained_layout ---
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(24, 19), facecolor=C_BG)

gs = fig.add_gridspec(2, 1, height_ratios=[2.8, 1], hspace=0.06,
                      left=0.06, right=0.97, top=0.92, bottom=0.06)

ax_timeline = fig.add_subplot(gs[0])
ax_invest = fig.add_subplot(gs[1])

# --- Helper: parse date string to ordinal ---
def parse_date(d):
    if '-' in d:
        return datetime.strptime(d, '%Y-%m').toordinal()
    else:
        return datetime(int(d), 7, 1).toordinal()

# --- Prepare timeline data ---
tracks = []
for track_key, label, color in [
    ('research_milestones', 'Research', C_RESEARCH),
    ('industry_milestones', 'Industry', C_INDUSTRY),
    ('regulation_milestones', 'Regulation', C_REGULATION),
]:
    events = []
    for e in data[track_key]['data']:
        events.append({
            'date': parse_date(e['date']),
            'label': e['label'],
            'significance': e['significance'],
            'detail': e['detail'],
        })
    tracks.append((label, color, events))

# --- Track positions ---
y_positions = {'Research': 3, 'Industry': 2, 'Regulation': 1, 'Investment': 0}
size_map = {'critical': 200, 'high': 120, 'medium': 65}
alpha_map = {'critical': 1.0, 'high': 0.88, 'medium': 0.70}

# --- Timeline subplot ---
for label, color, events in tracks:
    y = y_positions[label]
    # Subtle background band for each track
    ax_timeline.axhspan(y - 0.38, y + 0.38, facecolor=color, alpha=0.05, zorder=0)
    ax_timeline.axhline(y, color=color, alpha=0.12, linewidth=1, zorder=1)
    # Track label on left side
    ax_timeline.text(parse_date('2009-08'), y, label, fontsize=14,
                    fontweight='bold', fontfamily='serif', color=color,
                    ha='right', va='center')

# Plot events with manual label offset optimization
label_data = []  # collect for placement

for label, color, events in tracks:
    y = y_positions[label]
    for e in events:
        sz = size_map[e['significance']]
        al = alpha_map[e['significance']]
        ax_timeline.scatter(e['date'], y, s=sz, c=color, zorder=8,
                          alpha=al, edgecolors='white', linewidth=1.5)
        label_data.append({
            'date': e['date'],
            'y': y,
            'label': e['label'],
            'significance': e['significance'],
            'color': color,
        })

# Sort by date
label_data.sort(key=lambda x: x['date'])

# Custom label placement with per-event tuning
# For dense regions (2023-2024), use staggered offsets
placed = []  # (date, y_offset_used)

for item in label_data:
    d, y, lbl, sig, col = item['date'], item['y'], item['label'], item['significance'], item['color']

    # Start with default offset
    offset_y = 0.55

    # Determine direction: alternate, but prefer placing upward for top track and downward for bottom
    track_idx = list(y_positions.values()).index(y)

    # Default: alternate based on position in sorted list
    idx = label_data.index(item)
    if idx % 3 == 0:
        offset_y = 0.58
    elif idx % 3 == 1:
        offset_y = -0.58
    else:
        offset_y = 0.72

    # For critical events, push slightly further out
    if sig == 'critical':
        offset_y *= 1.1

    # For bottom track (Regulation), prefer labels below
    if y == y_positions['Regulation'] and offset_y > 0:
        offset_y = -abs(offset_y)
    # For top track (Research), prefer labels above
    if y == y_positions['Research'] and offset_y < 0:
        offset_y = abs(offset_y)

    # Check for nearby conflicts
    for pd_, poff in placed:
        if abs(d - pd_) < 200 and abs(offset_y - poff) < 0.3:
            # Try other side
            offset_y = -offset_y
            # If still conflicts, push further
            for pd2_, poff2 in placed:
                if abs(d - pd2_) < 180 and abs(offset_y - poff2) < 0.25:
                    offset_y *= 1.4
                    break

    placed.append((d, offset_y))

    # Font styling
    fw = 'bold' if sig == 'critical' else 'normal'
    fs = 8.5 if sig == 'critical' else 7.5

    # Horizontal alignment for edge dates
    if d < parse_date('2012-06'):
        ha = 'left'
    elif d > parse_date('2024-09'):
        ha = 'right'
    else:
        ha = 'center'

    ax_timeline.annotate(lbl, (d, y),
                        xytext=(0, offset_y * 42),
                        textcoords='offset points',
                        fontsize=fs, fontweight=fw,
                        color=col, ha=ha, va='center',
                        fontfamily='serif',
                        bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.15', facecolor=C_BG,
                                edgecolor='none', alpha=0.7))

# --- ChatGPT inflection vertical line (spans all tracks) ---
chatgpt_date = parse_date('2022-11')
ax_timeline.axvline(chatgpt_date, color=C_CHATGPT, linewidth=2.2,
                   linestyle='--', alpha=0.55, zorder=2)
ax_timeline.annotate('ChatGPT launches\nNovember 2022',
                    xy=(chatgpt_date, 3.65),
                    fontsize=10.5, fontweight='bold', color=C_CHATGPT,
                    ha='center', va='bottom', fontfamily='serif',
                    bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.4', facecolor='white',
                            edgecolor=C_CHATGPT, alpha=0.92))

# --- Lag annotation arrows ---
# Top: Transformer → ChatGPT (Research to Industry)
transformer_date = parse_date('2017-06')
y_lag_top = 3.38
ax_timeline.annotate('', xy=(chatgpt_date, y_lag_top),
                    xytext=(transformer_date, y_lag_top),
                    arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='<->', color=C_ANNOTATION,
                                  lw=2, connectionstyle='arc3,rad=0.05'))
mid_tc = transformer_date + (chatgpt_date - transformer_date) / 2
ax_timeline.text(mid_tc, y_lag_top + 0.18, '5.4 yr (research → industry)',
                fontsize=8, color=C_ANNOTATION, ha='center', va='bottom',
                fontfamily='serif', fontstyle='italic')

# Bottom: ChatGPT → Biden EO (Industry to Regulation)
biden_eo = parse_date('2023-10')
y_lag_bot = 0.62
ax_timeline.annotate('', xy=(biden_eo, y_lag_bot),
                    xytext=(chatgpt_date, y_lag_bot),
                    arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='<->', color=C_ANNOTATION,
                                  lw=2, connectionstyle='arc3,rad=-0.05'))
mid_cb = chatgpt_date + (biden_eo - chatgpt_date) / 2
ax_timeline.text(mid_cb, y_lag_bot - 0.2, '<1 yr (industry → regulation)',
                fontsize=8, color=C_ANNOTATION, ha='center', va='top',
                fontfamily='serif', fontstyle='italic')

# --- Density highlight zone (2023–2024) ---
density_start = parse_date('2023-01')
density_end = parse_date('2024-11')
ax_timeline.axvspan(density_start, density_end, facecolor=C_CHATGPT, alpha=0.035, zorder=0)
# Count events in 2010-2017 vs 2023-2024
count_early = sum(1 for item in label_data if item['date'] < parse_date('2018-01'))
count_late = sum(1 for item in label_data if item['date'] >= parse_date('2023-01'))
ax_timeline.text(density_start + (density_end - density_start) / 2, 3.7,
                f'{count_late} milestone events in 2023–2024\n(more than the {count_early} from 2010–2017)',
                fontsize=9, color=C_CHATGPT, ha='center', va='top',
                fontfamily='serif', fontweight='bold', alpha=0.75)

# --- Axis formatting (timeline) ---
year_ords = [datetime(y, 1, 1).toordinal() for y in range(2010, 2027)]
year_labels = [str(y) for y in range(2010, 2027)]
ax_timeline.set_xlim(datetime(2009, 4, 1).toordinal(), datetime(2026, 4, 1).toordinal())
ax_timeline.set_xticks(year_ords)
ax_timeline.set_xticklabels(year_labels, fontfamily='serif', fontsize=11.5, color=C_TEXT)
ax_timeline.set_ylim(0.2, 4.0)
ax_timeline.set_yticks([])
ax_timeline.tick_params(axis='x', length=5, colors=C_TEXT, pad=10)

# Light grid
ax_timeline.xaxis.grid(True, alpha=0.15, color=C_GRID, linewidth=0.5)
ax_timeline.set_axisbelow(True)

for spine in ax_timeline.spines.values():
    spine.set_visible(False)

# --- Legend (timeline) ---
# Significance
legend_sig = [
    Line2D([0], [0], marker='o', color='w', markerfacecolor='#475569',
           markersize=14, label='Critical'),
    Line2D([0], [0], marker='o', color='w', markerfacecolor='#64748b',
           markersize=10.5, label='High'),
    Line2D([0], [0], marker='o', color='w', markerfacecolor='#94a3b8',
           markersize=7.5, label='Medium'),
]
leg_sig = ax_timeline.legend(handles=legend_sig, loc='upper left',
                            fontsize=8.5, title='Event Significance',
                            title_fontsize=9, frameon=True,
                            facecolor='white', edgecolor=C_GRID,
                            framealpha=0.9, borderpad=0.6)
leg_sig.get_title().set_fontfamily('serif')
for t in leg_sig.get_texts():
    t.set_fontfamily('serif')

# Track colors
legend_track = [
    mpatches.Patch(color=C_RESEARCH, alpha=0.75, label='Research'),
    mpatches.Patch(color=C_INDUSTRY, alpha=0.75, label='Industry'),
    mpatches.Patch(color=C_REGULATION, alpha=0.75, label='Regulation'),
]
leg_track = ax_timeline.legend(handles=legend_track, loc='upper right',
                              fontsize=8.5, frameon=True,
                              facecolor='white', edgecolor=C_GRID,
                              framealpha=0.9, borderpad=0.6)
for t in leg_track.get_texts():
    t.set_fontfamily('serif')
ax_timeline.add_artist(leg_sig)

# ============================================================
# --- Investment subplot ---
# ============================================================
inv_data = data['ai_investment']['data']
years = np.array([d['year'] for d in inv_data])
investments = np.array([d['investment'] for d in inv_data])

# Color bars based on period
bar_colors = []
for y in years:
    if y == 2024:
        bar_colors.append(C_INVESTMENT)
    elif y == 2022:
        bar_colors.append('#a5b4fc')
    elif y == 2023:
        bar_colors.append('#c4b5fd')
    elif y > 2020:
        bar_colors.append('#ddd6fe')
    else:
        bar_colors.append('#ede9fe')

bars = ax_invest.bar(years, investments, color=bar_colors, width=0.72,
                    edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.6, zorder=3)

# Value labels on selected bars
highlight_years = {2010, 2015, 2017, 2020, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025}
for i, (y, inv) in enumerate(zip(years, investments)):
    if y in highlight_years:
        c = C_INVESTMENT if y == 2024 else C_TEXT
        ax_invest.text(y, inv + 5, f'${inv:.1f}B', ha='center', va='bottom',
                      fontsize=9.5, fontweight='bold', color=c,
                      fontfamily='serif')

# Doubling annotation
ax_invest.annotate('PRIVATE AI INVESTMENT\nDOUBLED IN 2 YEARS',
                  xy=(2024, 95.8), xytext=(2023, 128),
                  fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', color=C_INVESTMENT,
                  ha='center', va='bottom', fontfamily='serif',
                  arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=C_INVESTMENT,
                                lw=2, connectionstyle='arc3,rad=0.2'),
                  bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.5', facecolor='white',
                          edgecolor=C_INVESTMENT, alpha=0.92))

# ChatGPT marker on investment chart too
ax_invest.axvline(chatgpt_date if False else 2022.9, color=C_CHATGPT, linewidth=1.5,
                 linestyle='--', alpha=0.35, zorder=2)

# Investment axis
ax_invest.set_xlim(2009.2, 2025.8)
ax_invest.set_xticks(range(2010, 2026))
ax_invest.set_xticklabels([str(y) for y in range(2010, 2026)],
                         fontfamily='serif', fontsize=11.5, color=C_TEXT)
ax_invest.set_ylabel('Billion USD', fontfamily='serif', fontsize=13,
                    color=C_TEXT, fontweight='bold', labelpad=10)
ax_invest.set_ylim(0, 148)
ax_invest.tick_params(axis='y', labelsize=9.5, colors=C_TEXT)
ax_invest.tick_params(axis='x', length=5, colors=C_TEXT, pad=10)
ax_invest.yaxis.grid(True, alpha=0.15, color=C_GRID, linewidth=0.5)
ax_invest.set_axisbelow(True)

for spine in ax_invest.spines.values():
    spine.set_visible(False)

# ============================================================
# --- Titles ---
# ============================================================
fig.suptitle('The AI Acceleration: From Research Breakthroughs to Global Regulation',
            fontsize=24, fontweight='bold', fontfamily='serif', color='#0f172a',
            y=0.985)

fig.text(0.5, 0.955,
         'Three parallel tracks of AI evolution, 2010–2025 — showing how research leads, industry follows, and regulation responds',
         fontsize=11.5, fontfamily='serif', color='#64748b', ha='center',
         fontstyle='italic')

# Sub labels
ax_timeline.text(0.006, 0.985, 'A  TIMELINE OF EVENTS',
                transform=ax_timeline.transAxes,
                fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', fontfamily='serif',
                color='#94a3b8', va='top', alpha=0.8)
ax_invest.text(0.006, 0.95, 'B  GLOBAL PRIVATE AI INVESTMENT',
              transform=ax_invest.transAxes,
              fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', fontfamily='serif',
              color='#94a3b8', va='top', alpha=0.8)

# Caption
fig.text(0.5, 0.015,
         'Sources: industry reports, government publications, academic literature. Investment data from global private AI investment tracking (billion USD).',
         fontsize=7.5, fontfamily='serif', color='#94a3b8', ha='center')

# --- Save ---
fig.savefig('/app/output/result.png', dpi=150, facecolor=C_BG, edgecolor='none',
            bbox_inches='tight', pad_inches=0.4)
plt.close(fig)
print(f'Saved. Events 2010-2017: {count_early}, Events 2023-2024: {count_late}')
